messages.content: The Boston organizer has changed Thursday. My opening is now at 8:15 a.m., and it’s at Northeastern’s East Village building, 291 St. Botolph Street, not at Park Plaza. Does the Wednesday train still work?

Yes. The Acela is scheduled into South Station at 9:49 p.m. Wednesday. Allowing 10 minutes to get off the train and 15–25 minutes by taxi, you should reach Hilton Boston Park Plaza around 10:15–10:30 p.m. Your late arrival is already protected, so the room should be held. Even with a modest rail delay, there is ample time to check in and prepare before morning.
Confirm whether I can get breakfast there early enough. I don’t want the earlier start to turn into a rushed morning.

Park Plaza’s breakfast service begins at 6:30 a.m. Thursday. If you sit down at opening and finish by 7:05, you can return to the room briefly and leave by 7:30–7:35. Breakfast is not included in the reservation, so the existing $21 estimate still applies.
What is the most dependable way to East Village at that hour?

A taxi or rideshare is the simplest option with your materials. The trip is roughly 1.2 miles and usually takes 8–15 minutes then, but morning traffic can stretch it toward 20. Leaving at 7:35 gives you about 20 minutes of buffer before the 8:15 opening. Ask for the St. Botolph Street entrance rather than the main Northeastern campus.
And if no car comes promptly? I need a backup I can actually use.

Walk to Back Bay station, take the Orange Line one stop to Massachusetts Avenue, then walk about seven minutes to East Village. Allow approximately 22–27 minutes door to door, so switch to that plan by 7:38 if a car has not been assigned. Walking the full way would take about 24 minutes and is also viable in good weather.
So nothing needs changing: train, hotel, Friday lunch, and flight all stay as booked?

Correct. Keep the Wednesday 6:03 p.m. Acela arriving at 9:49 p.m., both confirmed hotels, Friday’s publisher lunch near the Public Garden, and the 5:18 p.m. nonstop to Denver. Park Plaza’s late check-in remains protected, breakfast starts at 6:30 a.m., and a 7:35 a.m. car departure covers the revised Thursday venue. No booking alteration is warranted; only add the Thursday morning ride, likely $12–$18, to the working estimate.
